items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And after Dolores left, there was another girl who joined.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, she'd been gone. Dolores Hawkins was there. And after Dolores left, there was another girl who joined. I think her old man used to play the saxophone or something. Gloria...Gloria...Gloria something. It wasn't Gloria Lynne; that's a Black singer.
